description: Connects a domain to a photographer website built with Kadrafolio and hosted on Vercel. Group site: A record on the apex and CNAME on www. Groups verify and verifywww: Vercel domain-ownership TXT records at _vercel, applied only when Vercel asks for them. Values are the ones Vercel assigns to the Kadrafolio project. For a subdomain use the website-subdomain template.
variableDescription: ip: IPv4 of the apex A record from the Vercel domain configuration of the Kadrafolio project (e.g. 216.198.79.1); cname and pool: label and pool number of the Vercel CNAME target for www (e.g. d1d4fc829fe7bc7c and 017 for d1d4fc829fe7bc7c.vercel-dns-017.com); verify, verifywww: Vercel ownership value for the apex and for www, the part after vc-domain-verify= (e.g. example.com,1a2b3c4d).
